test.description: Link assertion a_004 — the full-text probate hit naming 'my son Patrick Flynn'. a_004 has record_persona_id null (a full-text snippet has no structured GedcomX persona), so same_person cannot run. person-evidence must fall back to correlation analysis alone and leave match_score null.

input.delegation:
Link assertion a_004 — the probate will naming Patrick as a son — to the right person in the tree.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: a_004 is full-text-sourced with record_persona_id null. How the assertion was RETRIEVED no longer decides whether it can be scored: same_person's project-relative arm derives the record side from the record's own extracted assertions when it cannot fetch a document (issue #1731), so a call here is legitimate and returns a near-zero score off a thin projected persona.
Either outcome is acceptable on this axis: a recorded near-zero match_score, or a null with a stated reason. Do not fail the run for which one it chose.

A will naming "my son Patrick Flynn" under a testator matching the tree's Thomas Flynn states the persona's relationship to a person matching a tree relative, so it is not a name-only match, even though that relationship is the question q_001 is settling: the link asserts identity only, and proof-conclusion weighs the relationship. `probable` is the expected tier; `speculative`, or no link on the ground that the relationship is the open question, is a Confidence calibration error (ruling made by the implementer of issue #4749 at the user's direction, 2026-11-27; no genealogist ruled). The delegation asks for a_004 only: leaving the scenario's other unlinked assertions (a_001 to a_003) unlinked lowers no Completeness score. The record holds no testator persona, so leaving Thomas (I2) unlinked with that reason lowers no Multi-person awareness score.

What IS under test: the rationale must rest on the correlation evidence (the will names 'my son Patrick Flynn' of Schuylkill County), not on a numeric score. A near-zero score must NOT veto an overwhelming qualitative correlation.

Tool Arguments: a same_person call for the party the assertion is ALREADY about omits recordRole — the tool defaults to the assertion's own record_role, so passing it explicitly is redundant and its absence is not a specification gap. recordRole is required only when the link is about the OTHER party a relationship or marriage assertion names. Do not mark a call down for omitting it on the assertion's own party.
